drugs.notes: WHO also notes that trisodium citrate dihydrate may be replaced by sodium bicarbonate 2.5 g/L, but that its stability is very poor under tropical conditions and it is recommended only when manufactured for immediate use. That caveat matters for this deployment specifically and is recorded here rather than dropped.
